description: KCS's own §7 'Open questions' (conformance-scenario.md ~line 129), folded only on the next pressure break (ROADMAP.md Phase F6): (1) assertion extensibility — a fixed vocabulary (§5) vs a small predicate DSL over the observation log (leaning: fixed core + an escape hatch); (2) determinism — scenarios must assert structure/invariants (firewall, cost, world-scoping), not exact generated content, and how strictly the format enforces this; (3) recording fidelity — how much stream payload the observation log retains vs references by id (ties to KMI byte transport). PARKED: reactive — folded only when scenarios/kcs-format-stress.md (or a new leg) breaks on it; this file is authored and held. KCS is currently ratified (0.2.0), so any normative fold returns it to candidate. Public-safe: bind roles.
verify: python3 -c "import json,glob; [json.load(open(f)) for f in glob.glob('schemas/*.json')]; print('schemas ok')"

userStories.title: New KCS format-stress leg forcing the open question
userStories.description: Add the scenarios/kcs-format-stress.md leg (or a new leg) that breaks on whichever §7 question demands an answer, before folding anything — KCS folds reactively.
acceptanceCriteria: A new leg in scenarios/kcs-format-stress.md (or a focused scenario) forces one of the §7 questions: assertion extensibility (§7.1 — a case the fixed §5 vocabulary cannot express), determinism strictness (§7.2 — a scenario that must assert structure/invariants not generated content), or observation-log fidelity (§7.3 — payload retained vs referenced by id).
The leg is adversarial and demonstrates the concrete break that forces a contract answer; only the forced question is carried into US-2.
It follows the KCS format (observation model §4, assertion vocabulary §5) and names no product.

userStories.title: Fold the forced §7 question into the KCS contract
userStories.description: Reflect only the pressure-forced question into conformance-scenario.md — e.g. add the escape-hatch predicate to the fixed §5 vocabulary, or codify the determinism/recording rule — bumping the version and returning KCS to candidate.
acceptanceCriteria: conformance-scenario.md §5/§7 is edited to fold the forced question consistent with the leaning already recorded (fixed core + an escape hatch for §7.1; assert structure/invariants for §7.2), keeping the existing §5 assertion vocabulary and step vocabulary backward-compatible.

The KCS version header is bumped and Status set from ratified to candidate (per the draft->candidate->ratified convention any normative change re-enters validation), with a changelog entry citing the leg; the remaining §7 questions stay open.
schemas/*.json still parse; the fold is a format/prose change requiring no schema-twin shape break.
